title: viola calcarata subsp. cavillieri
intro: Viola calcarata subsp. cavillieri, commonly known as alpine pansy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Violaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. Research suggests that the health benefits of Viola calcarata subsp. cavillieri include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
